картина: Справка Gemini Apps (en-GB, версия Computer) о проверке, создан ли контент ИИ: две технологии — SynthID (невидимый водяной знак Google) и Content Credentials (стандарт C2PA). Требования и лимиты проверки (1 файл за раз, ≤100 МБ, видео <90 с, аудио <1 ч, ~10 проверок каждого типа за скользящие 24 ч), порядок загрузки и примеры вопросов, трактовка результатов (обнаружен/не обнаружен/неясно — слишком простое изображение или слишком малая правка), устойчивость знака к правкам, ручные способы распознавания (артефакты: текст, руки/зубы, фон, свет/тени, повторяющиеся узоры; обратный поиск; метаданные EXIF), FAQ по Content Credentials (версии 2.2+, список C2PA, нет удалённых метаданных, ошибки). Модели Nano Banana не названы; для правил генерации значимы свойства SynthID и перечень типичных артефактов.
модели_на_странице: не названы («Google's AI models», «Google AI tools»)

единицы.утверждение_en: Signed-in users can use a verification tool in the Gemini app to help identify images, videos and audio generated or edited by AI models.
единицы.цитата: You can use the verification tool available within the Gemini app for signed-in users, to help identify images, videos and audio generated or edited by AI models.
единицы.раздел: Verify AI-generated images, videos and audio (вступление)

единицы.утверждение_en: SynthID uses invisible watermarks to determine whether images, videos and audio were generated or edited specifically by Google's AI models.
единицы.цитата:
SynthID:
Uses invisible watermarks to determine if images, videos and audio were generated or edited specifically by Google's AI models.
единицы.раздел: Verify AI-generated images, videos and audio (вступление)

единицы.утверждение_en: Content Credentials act like a digital passport documenting a piece of content's origin and history, for both AI and non-AI content.
единицы.цитата:
Content Credentials:
A technology that acts like a digital passport, documenting the digital content's origin and history, and is used for both AI and non-AI content.
единицы.раздел: Verify AI-generated images, videos and audio (вступление)
единицы.заметка: Вторая технология проверки (стандарт C2PA, см. E-211-27).

единицы.утверждение_en: AI verification requires a personal or qualified Workspace account, the latest Gemini app version (if verifying in the app), and being signed in to Gemini Apps.
единицы.цитата:
To use AI verification, you need:
A personal account or qualified Workspace account
The latest version of the Gemini app if you use the app to verify content.
To be signed in to Gemini Apps.

единицы.утверждение_en: You can verify only a single image, video or audio file at a time, with a file size of 100 MB or less.
единицы.цитата: You can only choose a single image, video or audio file to verify at a time, and it should have a file size of 100 MB or less.

единицы.утверждение_en: Videos to verify must be under 90 seconds each and audio files under 1 hour each.
единицы.цитата: Videos need to be less than 90 seconds each and audio files need to be less than 1 hour each
единицы.заметка: Относится к видео/аудио, не к изображениям; оставлено как часть лимитов проверки.

единицы.утверждение_en: When verifying a screenshot of an image, crop tightly around the image for maximum accuracy and don't upload a collage of multiple distinct images.
единицы.цитата: If you're taking a screenshot of an image to verify, make sure that you crop tight around the image to get maximum accuracy, and don't upload a collage of multiple distinct images.

единицы.утверждение_en: To upload for verification on a computer: go to gemini.google.com, click Add files, then Upload files (device), More uploads > Photos (photo library) or Drive (Google Drive).
единицы.цитата:
Click Add files
.
To upload a supported file from your device, click Upload files
.
To upload a supported file from your photo library, click
More uploads
Photos
.
To add a supported file from your Google Drive, click Drive
.

единицы.утверждение_en: Adding files from Drive requires Keep activity to be on and Google Workspace connected to Gemini Apps (you'll be offered to connect it if not).
единицы.цитата: To add files from your Drive, you need to have Keep activity on and connect Google Workspace to Gemini Apps. If it's not connected, you'll get the option to connect it.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example verification question: 'Was this image/video/audio created or edited by Google AI?'
единицы.цитата: 'Was this image/video/audio created or edited by Google AI?'
единицы.заметка: Промпт-вопрос к Gemini для проверки (не промпт генерации). Прямо называет Google AI — соответствует области действия SynthID.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example verification question: 'Is this AI-generated?'
единицы.цитата: 'Is this AI-generated?'
единицы.заметка: Общий вопрос; ответ SynthID всё равно касается только Google AI (E-211-13).

единицы.утверждение_en: Example verification question: 'Is this a real video?'
единицы.цитата: 'Is this a real video?'
единицы.заметка: Для видео; включён как часть списка примеров.

единицы.утверждение_en: Although other companies have started adopting SynthID watermarks, Gemini can currently only recognise content created by Google AI tools.
единицы.цитата: While other companies have started to adopt SynthID watermarks, Gemini can currently only recognise content created by Google AI tools.

единицы.утверждение_en: If a SynthID watermark is detected, all or part of the image was created or edited by Google's AI models.
единицы.цитата: If a SynthID watermark is detected, it means that all or part of the image was created or edited by Google's AI models.
единицы.раздел: About the verification results › For SynthID
единицы.заметка: «All or part» — водяной знак есть и при частичной правке.

единицы.утверждение_en: If no SynthID watermark is detected, the image wasn't created or edited by Google AI, but it could have been created by other AI systems.
единицы.цитата: If a SynthID watermark isn't detected, it means that the image wasn't created or edited by Google AI, but it could have been created by other AI systems.
единицы.раздел: About the verification results › For SynthID

единицы.утверждение_en: Sometimes it is unclear whether content was created or edited by Google AI; common reasons are 'Not enough details to watermark' (very simple or abstract content) and 'Likely too small an edit' (minor alterations might not carry a detectable watermark).
единицы.цитата:
In some cases it isn’t clear if the image or video was created or edited by Google AI or not. Some common reasons for this are:
'Not enough details to watermark' (e.g. very simple or abstract content).
'Likely too small an edit' (minor alterations might not carry a detectable watermark).
единицы.раздел: About the verification results › For SynthID
единицы.заметка: Предел водяного знака: очень простые/абстрактные изображения и малые правки могут не нести обнаружимого SynthID.

единицы.утверждение_en: If content contains Content Credentials, you can view a summary of media composition, edit history, and whether or not AI was used.
единицы.цитата:
If the content contains Content Credentials, you can view a summary of:
Media composition.
Edit history.
Whether or not AI was used.
единицы.раздел: About the verification results › For Content Credentials

единицы.утверждение_en: Common artifacts of AI-generated images and videos include inconsistent or garbled text, errors in small details such as hands, teeth or background elements, inconsistent shadows and lighting, and unnaturally repetitive patterns.
единицы.цитата:
Examine images and videos for inconsistencies or errors that are common in AI-generated content. These can include:
Inconsistent or garbled text within the image or video.
Errors in small details, such as hands, teeth or background elements.
Inconsistent shadows and lighting.
Repetitive patterns that seem unnatural.
единицы.раздел: Other ways to identify AI-generated content
единицы.заметка: Google сам перечисляет типичные ошибки ИИ-изображений: текст, мелкие детали (руки, зубы, фон), свет/тени, повторяющиеся узоры. Применимость «промпт» — как перечень зон риска при генерации (контекст страницы — распознавание).

единицы.утверждение_en: Use reverse image search tools (e.g. Google Images) to find original sources or similar images and determine whether content has a known origin.
единицы.цитата: Use reverse image search tools (e.g. Google Images) to find original sources or similar images. This can help you determine if the content has a known origin or if it's new and not created or altered by AI.
единицы.раздел: Other ways to identify AI-generated content

единицы.утверждение_en: If you have the original file (not a screenshot), check embedded metadata; for photos this can include EXIF data with camera models, dates and settings.
единицы.цитата: If you have access to the original file (not a screenshot), you can check for embedded information. For photos, this can include EXIF data with camera models, dates and settings.
единицы.раздел: Other ways to identify AI-generated content

единицы.утверждение_en: Metadata can sometimes show whether professional editing software was used.
единицы.цитата: Metadata can sometimes show if professional editing software was used.
единицы.раздел: Other ways to identify AI-generated content

единицы.утверждение_en: SynthID embeds digital watermarks directly into content generated by Google's AI models and can currently be used to verify whether images, videos or audio were created or edited by Google AI tools.
единицы.цитата: SynthID is a tool that embeds digital watermarks directly into content generated by Google's AI models. Currently, it can be used to verify whether images, videos or audio files were created or edited by Google AI tools.

единицы.утверждение_en: The SynthID watermark usually survives re-scaling, re-colouring, compression or other alterations of the image, video or audio.
единицы.цитата: The digital watermark will usually still exist even if the image, video or audio is re-scaled, re-coloured, compressed or altered in other ways.

единицы.утверждение_en: After many alterations, there is still a chance that the SynthID watermark won't be detected.
единицы.цитата: However, there's still a chance that after many alterations the watermark won't be detected.

единицы.утверждение_en: Watermarks are embedded directly into content for verification and are not visible to users; metadata lets creators add context to original files; both increase transparency.
единицы.цитата: Watermarks are embedded directly into content and used for verification purposes. The digital watermarks are not visible to users. Metadata allows content creators to add additional context with original files to provide more information about the content. Both watermarks and metadata are used to increase transparency around AI-generated content.

единицы.утверждение_en: Verification quota: approximately 10 image checks, 10 video checks (up to 5 minutes total) and 10 audio checks (up to 3 hours total) within any 24-hour rolling window; the Gemini app notifies you at the limit.
единицы.цитата: There’s a usage quota of approximately 10 image checks, 10 video checks (up to 5 minutes total) and 10 audio checks (up to 3 hours total) within any 24-hour rolling window. If you reach these limits, the Gemini app will notify you.

единицы.утверждение_en: Content Credentials are an industry standard developed by the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA) that provides media history and transparency, including whether AI was involved, and are supported by many companies' products.
единицы.цитата: are a technology that provides media history and transparency, including whether AI was involved in the creation of the content. It is an industry standard developed by the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA), and is supported by many products from different companies.

единицы.утверждение_en: Content Credentials provide origin and history details via a cross-device, cross-app standard and information from the app or device maker about AI or non-AI tools used to create or edit a file.
единицы.цитата:
Provide details about the origin and history of content through a standard that works across devices and apps from different companies.
Provide information from the app or device maker about AI or non-AI tools used to create or edit an image, video or audio file.

единицы.утверждение_en: Content Credentials don't tell you whether a file is definitely AI-generated; use their origin and history information together with the content itself to decide.
единицы.цитата: Tell you if an image, video or audio file is definitely AI-generated, but you can use the origin and history information with the content itself to make informed decisions.

единицы.утверждение_en: Content Credentials verification works for files from devices and apps that support compatible versions of the Content Credentials format.
единицы.цитата: Content Credentials verification is available for image, video or audio files from devices and apps that support compatible versions of the Content Credentials format.

единицы.утверждение_en: When available, Content Credentials show the company that provided and cryptographically signed the information (e.g. 'Info by Google LLC'); the result may list more than one company.
единицы.цитата:
Show the company that provided and cryptographically signed the information. For example, 'Info by Google LLC' shows that Google provided the information.
The result may list more than one company.

единицы.утверждение_en: An 'incorrectly modified' error occurs when media history was tampered with or modified without an appropriate update of the C2PA data, since credentials rely on history maintained and signed by each editor.
единицы.цитата: Content Credentials are built on history that's maintained and signed by each editor of the file. If the media history was tampered with or modified without an appropriate update of the C2PA data, an error occurs.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini Apps support Content Credentials version 2.2 and later from products on the C2PA Conforming Products List; credentials from products outside it may not be considered valid or trusted.
единицы.цитата:
Gemini Apps supports Content Credentials versions 2.2 and later, from products on the
C2PA Conforming Products List
. Credentials from products outside that list may not be considered valid or trusted.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini Apps don't support Content Credentials metadata stored remotely, separate from the file.
единицы.цитата: Additionally, some third-party Content Credentials apps store the metadata remotely, separate from the image, video or audio file; Gemini Apps don't support remote metadata.

единицы.утверждение_en: An 'unrecognised' error means the file may contain malformed Content Credentials due to a bug in the app that generated it; Gemini Apps may detect but not interpret them.
единицы.цитата: A file may contain malformed Content Credentials when the app that generated the file experienced a bug. Gemini Apps may detect the Credentials, but can't interpret them in some cases.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: A negative SynthID check does not prove an image is authentic or non-AI: detection only covers Google AI, can fail on very simple/abstract images, very small edits, or after many alterations, and Content Credentials never establish AI origin definitively.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Страница говорит это по частям в разных разделах.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: For images generated or edited with Google's image models, a SynthID watermark is expected to persist through ordinary edits (resize, recolour, compression) and to mark even partial AI edits ('all or part'), with the exception of very small edits.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Nano Banana по имени на странице не упоминается; «Google's AI models» — общая формулировка.

не_сказано: Не названы конкретные модели (Nano Banana и др.) и не сказано, добавляют ли они Content Credentials к своим изображениям.
Нет порогов: сколько правок «много» для потери SynthID, насколько «мала» правка без знака.
О видимом водяном знаке Gemini не сказано ничего.
сомнения: Страница про проверку, а не про генерацию; единицы в основном политические/продуктовые, в правила генерации переносить с осторожностью (кроме свойств SynthID и перечня артефактов).
